items.title: FBI blames North Korea for stolen billions from Binance in biggest hack in history
items.summary:
The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest cryptocurrency heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI said on Saturday.
The bureau said in a statement that this week’s attack was tied to “malicious cyber activity” by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a US$1.5 billion Bybit hack last year.

items.title: Claude Code Game Restrictions Target Clones, But Developers Say Legitimate Projects Are Being Blocked
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced new Claude Code game restrictions designed to prevent its AI coding assistant from recreating existing video games. However, the change is already generating controversy, with some developers reporting that the restrictions are also interfering with their own projects. As first reported by Game Developer, the new instruction was discovered by X user Chasm, who claims it was introduced around October 27 through a server-delivered configuration identified as tengu_heron_br

items.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
items.summary:
How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe.
It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data.
Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI

confirmed_facts.text: This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions.

confirmed_facts.text: The end result: you could create a ChatGPT share URL which, when visited by another signed-in user, could exfiltrate their private data or take actions on their behalf.
